name: Types of AI
excerpt: Types of AI include assisted, augmented, and autonomous intelligence.
notes: Types of AI in decision making include assisted intelligence, which automates basic tasks; augmented intelligence, which automates more complex tasks; and autonomous intelligence, which involves machine learning for independent decision making.
context_summary:
- Types of AI include assisted, augmented, and autonomous intelligence.
- Assisted intelligence automates basic tasks.
- Augmented intelligence automates complex tasks.
- Autonomous intelligence involves machine learning for independent decisions.
